title: Grab and Move w/ Win modifier will open start menu
author: ibuildthecloud

status.label: Open Grab and Move fix already linked
status.detail: The only public comment on the issue links an open draft PR that targets exactly this Win-modified drag release-order bug and includes focused validation of both release sequences.

next_action.label: Track the linked Grab and Move PR
next_action.reason: A concrete upstream fix attempt is already open for the reported behavior.

judgment.rationale: Issue #49704 is already owned by open draft PR #49746, which explicitly says it prevents the Start menu from opening after a Win-modified Grab and Move interaction and documents validation for both Win-release orders.
evidence: The issue includes a video attachment and a repro that depends on releasing the mouse button before releasing Win.
The public comment on the issue says PR #49746 was opened specifically for this behavior.
PR #49746 is still open and describes the same cause: Windows treats the later Win key-up as a standalone Win press unless Grab and Move emits a dummy chord event.
judgment.recommended_action: Treat the issue as handled by the linked upstream PR and avoid a duplicate design.

fix_assessment.rationale: There is already a concrete upstream PR for this exact Grab and Move regression.

issue_context.summary: Using Win as the Grab and Move modifier can open Start on key release, but the issue already links an open upstream PR that specifically targets that release-order behavior.
known_information: The issue is on PowerToys v0.100.2 and Product-Grab And Move.
The Start menu opens only when the mouse button is released before the Win key.
A video attachment demonstrating both release orders is attached.
The only public comment links draft PR #49746 and summarizes its approach and validation.
inferences: The public ownership signal is strong enough that a second design or duplicate triage thread would add noise rather than value.
issue_context.analysis: Because the issue already has a live upstream PR with matching scope and validation, the right batch outcome is to mark it handled by linked work.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the full issue body, attachment, comment thread, and timeline cross-reference to PR #49746.
Inspected the linked PR summary and validation notes, which match the exact release-order scenario in the issue.
